after3_start.name: {name}
after3_start.text: *After school. My mind is a mess. Who should I go to first?*

after3_route_check.name: {name}
after3_route_check.text: *I check my phone. No reply, and the meeting time is just getting closer.*

after3_auto_dain.name: {name}
after3_auto_dain.text: *I have plans with Dain. Heading to the gym.*

after3_auto_yuna.name: {name}
after3_auto_yuna.text: *I have plans with Yuna. Heading to the library annex.*

after3_auto_seo.name: {name}
after3_auto_seo.text: *I have plans with Seoyeon. Heading to the student council room.*

after3_multi_choice.name: {name}
after3_multi_choice.text: *My plans overlapped. To be precise, I made them overlap. Running away would be even worse. Who should I go to first to fix this?*

after3_reject_for_seo_1.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_1.text: *I run into Dain in the hallway. Her usual energy is gone. The smile doesn't come first today.*

after3_reject_for_seo_2.name: Dain
after3_reject_for_seo_2.text: ...You're not coming to the gym today, are you?

after3_reject_for_seo_3.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_3.text: *I pass by the library. Yuna's seat is empty. One note remains. Pale violet ink. — 'I waited. Two hours. I won't wait any longer.'*

after3_reject_for_seo_4.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_4.text: *I step out to the hallway. Dain's sentence with no exclamation marks, Yuna's library with every trace erased. — Things that can't be undone are starting to pile up.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_1.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_1.text: *Seoyeon is organizing her clipboard in the hallway. Her hands turn the pages faster than usual.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_reject_for_yuna_2.text: Student council work is busy. I'll eat separately. ...Today.

after3_reject_for_yuna_walk_gym.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_walk_gym.text: *My feet carry me toward the gym.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_3.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_3.text: *Dain is hitting balls alone in the gym.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_3_react.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_3_react.text: *But she turns her face away. Her eyes are red.*

after3_reject_for_yuna_4.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_yuna_4.text: *I leave the gym and return to the hallway. Seoyeon pretended she was fine. Dain couldn't even do that. — Somehow, both hurt more that way.*

after3_reject_for_dain_1.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_dain_1.text: *Seoyeon is organizing her clipboard. She's smiling, but the fingers doing the organizing are too neat, too controlled.*

after3_reject_for_dain_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_reject_for_dain_2.text: ...I have some things to do today. I'll head out first.

after3_reject_for_dain_3.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_dain_3.text: *There is no note in the library. Yuna's bag is gone too. Only a lukewarm water ring remains on the desk, like she was here just moments ago.*

after3_reject_for_dain_3b.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_dain_3b.text: *I walked back to the hallway. Seoyeon's practiced smile, the water ring Yuna left behind. — The one who said nothing leaves a longer mark.*

after3_seo_1.name: {name}
after3_seo_1.text: *I opened the student council room door. — Seoyeon is slumped over the desk. First time I've ever seen her like this. The perfect student council president — defenseless on the desk.*

after3_seo_3.name: {name}
after3_seo_3.text: *Seoyeon lifts her head at the sound of someone entering. Her eyes look tired. Her makeup is slightly smudged.*

after3_seo_7.name: {name}
after3_seo_7.text: See what? I didn't see anything.

after3_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_8.text: This side of me. — This is a secret.

after3_seo_9.name: {name}
after3_seo_9.text: *Seoyeon straightens her posture. But — her usual perfect smile doesn’t return.*

after3_seo_choice.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_choice.text: Next time I ask you for a favor, you have to say yes. No questions asked. — Consider it payment.
choices: You don't have to be perfect. Anyone gets like this.
...Just now? I didn't see anything. I dropped my pen and came in to pick it up.

after3_seo_end.name: {name}
after3_seo_end.text: *Those words carry weight. — I think I’m starting to understand how monumental it is for this person to show an imperfect side of herself.*

after3_yuna_1.name: {name}
after3_yuna_1.text: *The library annex. Yuna’s secret reading nook. — The door is open.*

after3_yuna_2.name: {name}
after3_yuna_2.text: *I go in, but Yuna isn't here. Instead — a notebook lies open on the sofa. Filled with handwriting. It's a novel. A novel Yuna wrote. — Should I read it?*

after3_yuna_4.name: {name}
after3_yuna_4.text: *First page. 'One day a transfer student came. He found the library and sat next to me without saying a word. — I didn't mind it.'*

after3_yuna_7.name: {name}
after3_yuna_7.text: *Yuna’s voice from behind. I turn around and she’s standing there holding two drinks. — She freezes when she sees me looking at the notebook.*

after3_yuna_8b.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_8b.text: *Quickly approaches and snatches the notebook* ...I didn't say you could.

after3_yuna_9.name: {name}
after3_yuna_9.text: *Her ears. Red. — It’s the first time I’ve seen Yuna blush.*

after3_yuna_choice.name: {name}
choices: This is about me, isn't it? 'A transfer student who sat without a word' — that's me.
This author is really good. Is there a sequel? I'd love to borrow it.

after3_yuna_end.name: {name}
after3_yuna_end.text: *Yuna clutches the notebook tightly to her chest.*

after3_dain_1.name: {name}
after3_dain_1.text: *The gym. Dain is stretching alone. She tries a light jog and — — her right leg twists slightly. She winces.*

after3_dain_4.name: Dain
after3_dain_4.text: Ah! I’m fine!! It’s just a little twist!!

after3_dain_6.name: {name}
after3_dain_6.text: *Too many exclamation marks. — Way too many. Does this girl use more exclamation marks when she’s not okay?*

after3_dain_choice.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice.text: *Dain sits on the bench. She rubs her knee.*
choices: Sit next to her and wait quietly
Got any patches? I’ll go get them

after3_dain_choice1.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice1.text: *I sit beside her without a word. Dain glances my way.*

after3_dain_choice1_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice1_3.text: Because you’d just say you’re fine.

after3_dain_choice1_react.name: {name}
after3_dain_choice1_react.text: *Dain hesitates. — Then smiles, small. A smile I've never seen before.*

after3_dain_end.name: {name}
after3_dain_end.text: *Dain lightly punches my shoulder with her fist. — Weaker than yesterday.*

after3_dain_end_first.name: {name}
after3_dain_end_first.text: *Dain lightly punches my shoulder. — She seems embarrassed.*

after3_confront_1.name: {name}
after3_confront_1.text: *Coming out of the after-school spot — Seoyeon is waiting in the hallway. Arms crossed. Her usual composure is gone.*

after3_confront_3.name: {name}
after3_confront_3.text: *Seoyeon leads me to the end of the hallway. Where no one else is.*

after3_confront_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_5.text: When you smiled the same way at other people, I kind of hated it.

after3_confront_6.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_6.text: Be honest. Did you promise all of us the weekend?

after3_confront_choice.name: {name}
after3_confront_choice.text: *Seoyeon looks straight at me. Not with the eyes of a student council president. With the eyes of just a person.*
choices: The time slots are different, so I thought it would be fine
You’re the only one I’m serious about

after3_confront_admit_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_2.text: That’s the cruelest thing you can say, {name}. Kindness that can’t refuse — gives people false hope.

after3_confront_admit_3.name: {name}
after3_confront_admit_3.text: *Seoyeon picks up her lunch bag. Her hands are trembling.*

after3_confront_admit_4.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_4.text: You told me I didn’t have to be perfect — and then you tried to be the perfect person for everyone. That’s worse.

after3_confront_admit_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_admit_5.text: ...I won’t be leaving the rooftop open today.

after3_confront_admit_6.name: {name}
after3_confront_admit_6.text: *Her back is straight. Perfectly. — But her fists are clenched. Her knuckles are white.*

after3_confront_excuse.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_excuse.text: ...You don’t see how that’s the problem?

after3_confront_excuse_2.name: Seoyeon
after3_confront_excuse_2.text: It's not about how many people you made plans with. It's about what that promise meant to me.

after3_confront_lie_2.name: {name}
after3_confront_lie_2.text: *Eyes that want to believe. — I didn’t know a lie could weigh this much.*

after3_confront_end.name: {name}
after3_confront_end.text: *I’m standing alone in the hallway where Seoyeon disappeared. — Her posture was straight. Perfectly straight. But her fists were clenched.*

after3_final.name: {name}
after3_final.text: *After school is over. — What I saw today won’t leave my mind.*

haeun_warn_1.name: {name}
haeun_warn_1.text: *I stepped out of the student council room. The hallway is empty. — Someone was waiting.*

haeun_warn_3.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_3.text: Did you just see Seoyeon? My senior?

haeun_warn_4.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_4.text: ...She cried. After she left the student council room. In the bathroom. — I was the only one who saw. In a whole year, I've never seen her cry.

haeun_warn_5.name: {name}
haeun_warn_5.text: *Seoyeon cried. — All she said to me was that I'd 'seen her imperfect side.' But after that, she cried.*

haeun_warn_5b.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_5b.text: Sunbae is someone who thinks she has to be perfect. Someone who thinks crying means losing.

haeun_warn_6.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_6.text: The fact that she cried — that means she really cares about you, {name}.

haeun_warn_7.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_7.text: I know I'm butting in. But I'm worried about her. — Things at home are complicated for her right now. Her parents are... ...anyway. Please be good to her. I'm asking you.

haeun_warn_8.name: {name}
haeun_warn_8.text: *I can't get the image out of my head — Seoyeon crying alone in the bathroom. That perfectly straight back, those white-knuckled fists, and — an empty bathroom.*

haeun_warn_8b.name: {name}
haeun_warn_8b.text: *I walked out to the school entrance.*

after3_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_freetalk.text: *Standing face to face with Seoyeon in the hallway. Her expression is complicated.*
after3_seo_freetalk.context: Day 3 afterschool, right after confrontation/reconciliation with Seoyeon. Trust is shaken. Tone: Bright on the surface but shadows underneath. Sometimes smiling but eyes aren't. Sincerity peeks through casual conversation.
after3_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool student council president. Strong possessiveness, direct when jealous. Hurt but trying not to show it.

after3_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_freetalk.text: *Walking alongside Yuna. Her gaze is cool.*
after3_yuna_freetalk.context: Day 3 afterschool, just talked with Yuna. She's showing more emotion than usual. Tone: Bright on the surface but shadows underneath. Sometimes smiling but eyes aren't. Sincerity peeks through casual conversation.
after3_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is a mysterious literary girl. Usually calm but emotionally shaken now. More about wanting confirmation than jealousy.

after3_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
after3_dain_freetalk.text: *Sitting on a bench with Dain at the playground. She's quieter than usual.*
after3_dain_freetalk.context: Day 3 afterschool, just talked with Dain. She's hurt but pretending to be cheerful. Tone: Bright on the surface but shadows underneath. Sometimes smiling but eyes aren't. Sincerity peeks through casual conversation.
after3_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic athlete. Being cheerful is her only defense. Fewer exclamation marks mean she's being real.

after3_seo_7_b.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_7_b.text: *Looks down* ...I really didn't want you to see this.

after3_dain_5_b.name: Dain
after3_dain_5_b.text: I told you I'm fine!! It's nothing!!

after3_confront_5_b.name: Dain
after3_confront_5_b.text: *With her head lowered.* ...I didn't like it either.

after3_confront_5_c.name: {name}
after3_confront_5_c.text: *She accepted it. — This is the first time Dain hasn't refused someone's help. A smile without exclamation marks feels strangely heavy.*

haeun_warn_5c_b.name: Seoyeon
haeun_warn_5c_b.text: When you smiled the same way at other people, I kind of hated it.

after3_confront_excuse_b.name: {name}
after3_confront_excuse_b.text: *Seoyeon's eyes are cold. A temperature I've never seen before.*

after3_confront_lie_2_b.name: {name}
after3_confront_lie_2_b.text: *Her back is straight. Perfectly. — But her fists are clenched. Her knuckles are white.*

haeun_warn_1_b.name: {name}
haeun_warn_1_b.text: *Haeun is leaning against the wall. She's fiddling with her student council bracelet.*

haeun_warn_2_b.name: {name}
haeun_warn_2_b.text: Haeun? What are you doing here?

haeun_warn_7_b.name: {name}
haeun_warn_7_b.text: *Haeun stops herself. Her face says she knows she shouldn't cross the line.*

haeun_warn_7_c.name: Haeun
haeun_warn_7_c.text: ...Anyway. Please be good to her. I'm asking you.

after3_reject_for_seo_3b.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_3b.text: *Yuna's book is gone. Volume 1 that always sat there. Volume 2 she promised to lend me. And — the bookmark too. The old bookmark she kept so carefully.*

after3_reject_for_seo_3c.name: {name}
after3_reject_for_seo_3c.text: *She erased every trace. This wasn't a note left behind — it was a line drawn. For Yuna to write this many words, she must have waited a long time.*

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_2.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_2.text: Your knee. You've been rubbing it this whole time. This isn't from twisting it today, is it?

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_3.text: *Dain's expression hardens. The exclamation marks vanish.*

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_4.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_4.text: ...Why bring it up if you knew. You know the tournament is next week.

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_5.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_5.text: Your knee matters more than the tournament.

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_6.name: Dain
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_6.text: That's not your call to make!!

after3_dain_dilemma_tell_7.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_tell_7.text: *Dain stands up. Her knee creaks. Her hand stops halfway to her shoelaces.*

after3_dain_dilemma_final.name: {name}
after3_dain_dilemma_final.text: *Dain's eyes are wet. A Dain without exclamation marks — I've never seen it before.*

after3_dain_tell_confirm_2.name: {name}
after3_dain_tell_confirm_2.text: *Dain grabs her bag and walks out. She doesn't look back. The gym door slams shut.*

after3_dain_tell_confirm_3.name: {name}
after3_dain_tell_confirm_3.text: *I stand alone in the empty gym. With Sojeong, I regretted keeping silent. This time, I spoke up. — But I don't know if it was right.*

after3_dain_tell_retreat.name: {name}
after3_dain_tell_retreat.text: *Dain breathes a sigh of relief. — I picked silence again. The easy way out.*

after3_seo_pity_trap_1.name: {name}
after3_seo_pity_trap_1.text: *Seoyeon slowly raises her head. Her face is — exactly zero. Not cold, not sad. Which is worse.*

after3_seo_pity_trap_4.name: {name}
after3_seo_pity_trap_4.text: *Seoyeon wipes the smudged makeup with the back of her hand. Slowly. Every motion measured. She's recovering.*

after3_seo_pity_trap_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_5.text: I didn't become student council president to be 'anyone.'

after3_seo_pity_trap_6.name: {name}
after3_seo_pity_trap_6.text: *The president's face is back. One degree harder than usual. — A face built to bury the unguarded Seoyeon I just saw, *forever*.*

after3_seo_pity_trap_7.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_pity_trap_7.text: Could you leave? I have work.

after3_seo_pity_trap_10.name: {name}
after3_seo_pity_trap_10.text: *I closed the council room door behind me. The hallway was empty. — I tried to comfort her. Sincerely. But for Seoyeon, 'anyone' wasn't comfort, it was demotion. I flattened seven years of her work into a single word.*

after3_seo_correct_1.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_1.text: *Seoyeon stops. For a moment — just a moment — her words break off. Her eyes searching to confirm whether I really didn't see anything.*

after3_seo_correct_2.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_2.text: *I bend down, pretending to pick up a pen. Fumbling under the desk. Slowly, on purpose. — Not looking at her. The moment I look, the lie cracks.*

after3_seo_correct_3.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_3.text: Oh, here it is. — Madam President, is this council room a place where pens go missing?

after3_seo_correct_4.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_4.text: *I look up. Seoyeon is — wiping the smudged makeup off with the back of her hand. Naturally. As if she'd needed to do it from the start.*

after3_seo_correct_5.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_5.text: ...The disappearing pens are an actual mystery. Thirty a year.

after3_seo_correct_6.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_6.text: The president can't even catch the culprit?

after3_seo_correct_7.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_7.text: *A small laugh.* If I caught them — students would start fearing the council.

after3_seo_correct_8.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_8.text: *The conversation flows naturally. The person who'd been slumped over the desk, the one with smudged makeup — *neither of them existed* in this council room. We agreed on that. Without saying so.*

after3_seo_correct_11.name: Seoyeon
after3_seo_correct_11.text: About picking up the pen. — Come pick it up again sometime.

after3_seo_correct_12.name: {name}
after3_seo_correct_12.text: *I never said I'd keep her secret. Not saying it was the answer. — For Seoyeon, weakness has to *never have existed*. Only to someone who understood that does Seoyeon offer not a pinky promise but a next appointment.*

after3_yuna_decode_trap_1.name: {name}
after3_yuna_decode_trap_1.text: *Yuna clutches the notebook tighter. Her knuckles go white.*

after3_yuna_decode_trap_3.name: {name}
after3_yuna_decode_trap_3.text: Not? But look at this part — 'reading by the classroom window—'

after3_yuna_decode_trap_5.name: {name}
after3_yuna_decode_trap_5.text: *Yuna shoves the notebook into her bag. Not her usual slow movements. A hand running away.*

after3_yuna_decode_trap_6.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_6.text: ...People like you — that's why I can't write.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_8.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_8.text: If I get caught even inside fiction — there's nowhere left to escape.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_9.name: {name}
after3_yuna_decode_trap_9.text: *Yuna shoulders her bag and stands up. Heads for the ladder. Doesn't look back as usual — no, this time she *can't* look back.*

after3_yuna_decode_trap_10.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_decode_trap_10.text: ...This place. I'm locking it from now on.

after3_yuna_decode_trap_11.name: {name}
after3_yuna_decode_trap_11.text: *Footsteps going down the ladder. I'm alone in the attic. Where the notebook had been, only fingerprints remain. — I learned that noticing is love. But for some people, *pretending not to notice* is love. For Yuna, fiction was *the place she escaped reality to*. Following her even there meant breaking her last refuge.*

after3_yuna_correct_1.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_1.text: *Yuna's grip on the notebook loosens — just slightly. For maybe one second.*

after3_yuna_correct_3.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_3.text: Yeah. Whose is this? Was it published?

after3_yuna_correct_5.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_5.text: Shame. Something this good shouldn't stay buried.

after3_yuna_correct_6.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_6.text: *Yuna sets the notebook back down on the desk. The hand that had been clutching it — slowly relaxes. The hand that had been *defending* the notebook becomes a hand *displaying* it.*

after3_yuna_correct_9.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_9.text: ...Let's just say the author allows it.

after3_yuna_correct_10.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_10.text: *Yuna holds the notebook out. With both hands. Not the way you lend a book — the way you *deliberately* hand something over.*

after3_yuna_correct_11.name: {name}
after3_yuna_correct_11.text: *The notebook lands heavy in my hands. Not the weight of paper. — A weight only someone who knows Yuna is *the author* and yet *doesn't say so* can ever be handed.*

after3_yuna_correct_12.name: Yuna
after3_yuna_correct_12.text: When you're done — write one line for the author. Anonymously.

after3_dain_pity_trap_1.name: {name}
after3_dain_pity_trap_1.text: *Dain's hand stops rubbing her knee. Slowly, she lifts her head.*

after3_dain_pity_trap_3.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_3.text: Hey. I'm not pushing it. This is just — bad form.

after3_dain_pity_trap_4.name: {name}
after3_dain_pity_trap_4.text: *Dain stands up. Pretends not to notice her knee trembling slightly. Grabs her bag.*

after3_dain_pity_trap_5.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_5.text: ...Don't look at me like that. Not you too.

after3_dain_pity_trap_8.name: {name}
after3_dain_pity_trap_8.text: *Dain walks toward the gym door. She doesn't run like usual. That hurts more.*

after3_dain_pity_trap_9.name: Dain
after3_dain_pity_trap_9.text: Coach does it. My parents do it. Everyone does it. — I thought you wouldn't.

after3_dain_pity_trap_10.name: {name}
after3_dain_pity_trap_10.text: *The gym door closes. Not with the usual slam. Quietly. — That's heavier. I made the face Dain hates most. Knowing it. With good intentions. That makes it worse.*

after3_dain_correct_1.name: {name}
after3_dain_correct_1.text: *Dain stops. — She expected the knee question. She expected to be treated like a patient. A faint crack in her expression.*

after3_dain_correct_5.name: {name}
after3_dain_correct_5.text: Is that good weird or bad weird.

after3_dain_correct_6.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_6.text: ...I don't know. But pick up the ball first. You really won't catch this one.

after3_dain_correct_7.name: {name}
after3_dain_correct_7.text: *Dain stands up. Rolls her knee once, lightly. Unconsciously. And then — sets up her toss. Same as always.*

after3_dain_correct_9.name: {name}
after3_dain_correct_9.text: *The serve flies. I miss it. The ball hits my wrist and ricochets off the ceiling. Dain claps and laughs. A real laugh. First one today.*

after3_dain_correct_11.name: {name}
after3_dain_correct_11.text: *As Dain lands — her right knee buckles slightly. One second. Her face is still smiling but her hand goes to the knee. This time she doesn't hide it. There's no need to hide it anymore.*

after3_dain_correct_12.name: Dain
after3_dain_correct_12.text: ...You know what. This thing. It's been going on a while.
